text: A repository says how its changes are checked in a version 1 .invariant/repository.json on its base branch, which internal/repository loads from a committed revision only (#461, the first step of #452's plan). Each part names its directory, its language, Go, Python or TypeScript, a toolchain image pinned by digest, its lockfiles and other dependency inputs, and its install, format, lint, build, test and one-test commands as argument arrays, never shell text. A check that doesn't apply says why. The file also names the repository's agent rules, its current-state documents, extra trusted paths and shared paths. Its authority comes only from the base commit's tree, read by blob ID, so a candidate's edits can't change the commands or the trust it's checked by. A touched path belongs to its deepest enclosing part, plus the parts that share it or name it as a dependency input. The file, the agent rules and the current-state documents select every part, and a path no part owns fails the whole selection. The file and its loader are in Invariant's trusted base. Nothing runs yet: plumbing on other repositories stays off until the plan's last step, and Invariant's own plumbing keeps its runner, commands, scope and sandbox without the file.
